name: Directus | Headless CMS and Instant REST/GraphQL API on Postgres
description: Directus 12 headless CMS + PostGIS + bucket, admin ready, no Redis bill
card_desc: Directus: turn a Postgres database into a headless CMS with REST and GraphQL APIs and a no-code admin app. Comes with PostGIS, file uploads in a Railway bucket and an admin account ready at first boot.
